core_obligations: Choose an affine open neighbourhood U of x with image in V and apply the unramified factorization lemma to get a factorization of U to V through affine space of relative dimension r (proof lines 3551-3553).

Apply the geometric structure lemma for the resulting unramified morphism to obtain the composite factorization in which the arrows into affine spaces are immersions and the projection between them is standard etale (proof lines 3554-3560).
Read off the two alternatives of the statement from that factorization, the second by taking D to be the intermediate scheme (proof lines 3561-3562).
proof_roadmap: Unramified factorization through affine space (proof lines 3551-3553).
Geometric structure of the unramified morphism (proof lines 3554-3560).
difficulty_reason: For f: X to S locally of finite type, a point x with image s and an affine open neighbourhood V of s, the lemma produces, with r the dimension of the fibre of the relative differentials at x, either a factorization of f over an affine neighbourhood of x through affine space of relative dimension r+1 with an immersion as first arrow, or one through a scheme smooth of relative dimension r over V with a closed immersion as first arrow (statement lines 3520-3548). The proof applies the unramified factorization lemma to the restriction of f over V to get a morphism to affine space of relative dimension r which is unramified at x, and then applies the geometric structure lemma for unramified morphisms to build the displayed factorization in which the two arrows into affine spaces are immersions and the projection is standard etale (proof lines 3550-3562). Both alternatives are then read off from that factorization. The claim is H2: two cited factorization results chained together, with no construction beyond choosing the affine neighbourhood.
